source_text: Tunica linea ad cutem — castitas interior. Homo communis peccatis servus; sacerdos novus induitur Christo.
pass_a_gloss: Tunic linen to skin — chastity interior. Man common to-sins slave; priest new is-clothed with-Christ.
pass_b_english: The [[linen tunic against the skin >> Bible:Leviticus 16:4]] is inward chastity. The “common” man is sin’s slave; the new priest is [[clothed with Christ >> Bible:Galatians 3:27]].
